syllabusSource.title: Pharmacy Council of India, M.Pharm syllabus: Pharmaceutics (MPH), MPH 202T Advanced Biopharmaceutics and Pharmacokinetics (also in the Gazette of India M.Pharm syllabus, 11 August 2026)

units.title: Drug absorption from the gastrointestinal tract, dissolution and the transport model
Biopharmaceutic drug product design and in vitro product performance (dissolution, IVIVC)
Pharmacokinetic models: compartmental and non-compartmental analysis
Nonlinear pharmacokinetics and drug interactions (binding, CYP450, transporters)
Applications of pharmacokinetics: modified-release, targeted and biotechnological products, PK/PD
